result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a broken or missing image placeholder. The clipped carousel items and the partially visible card at the bottom are intentional scroll cues and were not reported.

issues.description: The hero image for Tokumaru Ramen Bar failed to load. A grey placeholder with a broken-image icon appears in its place, which makes the featured card look broken.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL or add a fallback image. Show a neutral branded placeholder with no broken-image icon if the photo is unavailable.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is a semi-transparent grey circle on a grey placeholder, so its icon has low contrast and is hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Give the favorite button a solid background or a stronger outline so the icon stands out against any image or placeholder.
